roles.title: Roles
roles.subtitle: Define what each admin role can see and do across the portal. System roles can be tuned; custom roles can be cloned and deleted.
roles.cloned: Role cloned — review and save its permissions
roles.deleteBlocked: Reassign the {{count}} admin(s) using this role before deleting it.

roleEditor.subtitle: Configure the identity and permission matrix for this role. Every change is written to the audit log.
roleEditor.keyHint: Lowercase identifier used by the API, e.g. regional_manager
roleEditor.permissionsHint: Granting any action automatically grants View for that module.
roleEditor.protected: Super Admin is a protected system role. Its permissions are locked so the security team can never lock itself out.
roleEditor.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and underscores
roleEditor.keyTaken: This key is already used by another role

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Side-by-side comparison of what every role is allowed to do, per module and action.

admins.title: Admin users
admins.subtitle: Staff accounts with access to this console. Invite teammates, adjust roles and enforce MFA.
admins.inviteSub: They will receive an email with a secure link to set a password and enroll in 2FA.
admins.deactivateBody: They will be signed out of every session and lose access immediately. You can reactivate them later.
admins.cannotSelf: You cannot deactivate your own account
admins.resetMfaBody: Their authenticator enrollment will be removed and they must enroll again at next sign-in.
admins.emailTaken: An admin with this email already exists

audit.title: Audit logs
audit.subtitle: Immutable trail of every administrative action — who did what, when, from where, and what changed.
audit.noDiff: This action has no recorded field changes.
audit.liveHint: New actions from any page appear here instantly.

sessions.title: Admin sessions
sessions.subtitle: Active sign-ins to the admin console. Revoke any session you don't recognise.
sessions.revokeBody: {{name}} will be signed out on {{device}} immediately.
sessions.revokeAllBody: {{count}} session(s) will be signed out immediately. Your current session stays active.
sessions.cannotCurrent: Use Log out to end your current session

alerts.title: Suspicious activity
alerts.subtitle: Automated detections across student and admin accounts. Resolve false positives or block the account.
alerts.subject: Account
alerts.resolveBody: Use this for false positives or after the issue has been handled.
alerts.blockBodyStudent: The student account will be locked and signed out of all devices until support unlocks it.
alerts.blockBody: The source will be blocked and the alert closed.
alerts.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Confirmed credential sharing across 5 devices
alerts.noAlertsHint: When detections fire they will appear here.
